Backdrop.why: A suggestion popup is non-modal by design — it must not dim or `aria-hidden` the form it sits in (the `inline` arm exists for when even an overlay is too much; a backdrop is the opposite direction). Ends if the seal ever gains a modal arm. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Icon.why: Pairs with `Trigger` (the chevron inside it); meaningless without one. Ends with `Autocomplete.Trigger`'s row. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Row.why: Grid/column item layout. This seal's items are plain display strings (one line each), so a row wrapper has nothing to lay out. Ends when the popup gains multi-column items. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Separator.why: Group boundaries here are the `GroupLabel` headers, and the Combobox seal renders groups IDENTICALLY on purpose (the two listbox popups must not drift into two looks). `Select` does add a rule because its grouped popup is a dense single-line row list with no header spacing. Re-implemented per-component in 1.7 (#5399). Ends if a review rules the header boundary too weak — then it is ONE decision across all three seals, not a per-seal patch. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Trigger.why: This seal opens on focus/typing, not on a chevron press — a trigger button beside a text input reads as a Select and invites the wrong primitive (R4). Pick `Select` for a button-opened fixed list. Ends if the open-on-press interaction is ever wanted here. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

useFilter.why: not an anatomy part — a hook/type export has nothing to render.

useFilteredItems.why: not an anatomy part — a hook/type export has nothing to render.

Value.why: The seal's value IS the input's text (`value`/`onValueChange` on the Root); a separate Value display element has nothing to show that the input isn't already showing. Ends if the seal gains a non-text value display. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

CheckboxGroup.why: no @orb/ui seal wraps this component — there is no seal for the part to appear in. Ends when a seal is added: regenerate and the parts arrive `unresolved` for adjudication.

Backdrop.why: A suggestion popup is non-modal by design — it must not dim or `aria-hidden` the form it sits in (the `inline` arm exists for when even an overlay is too much; a backdrop is the opposite direction). Ends if the seal ever gains a modal arm. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Clear.why: The per-chip `ChipRemove` (exposed) is the removal affordance; a clear-all button that silently drops N committed chips has no undo at this seam. Ends when it can be added WITH a confirmation story, not as a bare part. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Icon.why: Pairs with `Trigger`; meaningless without one. Ends with `Combobox.Trigger`'s row. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

ItemIndicator.why: Selection is shown as CHIPS in the input, which is the stronger signal and always visible; a check mark in the list would state the same fact twice. Ends if the chips display is dropped. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Label.why: Labeling is `<Field>`'s job repo-wide (the settings/forms migration) or `aria-label`; a second label mechanism inside the seal is a second home for the same concept. Ends if `<Field>` stops owning labeling. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Row.why: Grid/column item layout. This seal's items are plain display strings (one line each), so a row wrapper has nothing to lay out. Ends when the popup gains multi-column items. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Separator.why: Group boundaries here are the `GroupLabel` headers, and the Combobox seal renders groups IDENTICALLY on purpose (the two listbox popups must not drift into two looks). `Select` does add a rule because its grouped popup is a dense single-line row list with no header spacing. Re-implemented per-component in 1.7 (#5399). Ends if a review rules the header boundary too weak — then it is ONE decision across all three seals, not a per-seal patch. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Trigger.why: Same as Autocomplete's: this is a chips-and-typing surface, not a button-opened list. Ends with `Autocomplete.Trigger`'s row. (docs/law/ui-package-design.md §14)

Indicator.why: THE §10 hybrid: `MeterIndicator` hardcodes `width:%` (linear only), so the arc/bipolar geometry is hand-drawn SVG riding as `Meter.Root`'s children.
